proof.criterion: A1/A2 the fold validates its tree once and calls no ToDelta
proof.surface: Dispatch CPU profiles of the six runs
proof.command: go tool pprof -peek 'pmdoc\.\(\*Node\)\.Validate$' '-show_from=docs\.\(\*Service\)\.foldDocument' <bin> cpu.pprof; go tool pprof -top -cum -show_from=foldDocument (prof.sh)
proof.observed: base: 4 callers of Validate (wantDocument, readDocument, render, AppendTokenJSON) in all three runs; head: 1 (readDocument) in all three; crdt.(*YText).ToDelta under foldDocument in every base profile, in no head profile
proof.negativeControl: The same peek on the base profiles finds four callers and ToDelta, so it finds them when present

proof.criterion: A6 tokens, /text and /blocks byte-identical on every LINUX spec
proof.surface: (a) the fold's own code over all 1,205 LINUX specs fetched fresh from production; (b) Dispatch's HTTP API on the local stack
proof.command: (a) GOWORK=off DISPATCH_TOKEN_CORPUS=<corpus> DISPATCH_TOKEN_CORPUS_OUT=tokens-<side>.jsonl go test ./internal/dispatch/docs/ -run '^TestTokenCorpus$' at base and head, cmp; (b) httpget.py: GET /text and /blocks for 1,060 artifacts and /blocks/{id} for every block of 110, base binary then head binary, diff -r
proof.observed: (a) both dumps sha256 d632f4062968f3729b6979c51d13f43de23ad45c7d52be2a5c68d98fa454db60, 1,205 lines, identical; (b) 7,048 requests per side, all 200, diff -r of bodies and headers empty, including 60 real LINUX specs carrying 15 edits and 150 anchored comments across bold, link and code runs
proof.negativeControl: A head binary whose run snapshot aliases the live mark set (runAttrs = current) changes 2,230 of 7,048 HTTP answers (1,060 /text, 1,170 /blocks)

proof.command: bun gen.mjs out 15000 23 (Yjs 13.6.32, 2-4 concurrent clients, partial syncs, gc on/off); TESTER_YJS_DIR=out go test ./internal/dispatch/pmdoc/ -run TestTesterYjsHistories (throwaway, in dispatch://INFRA-692/artifact/tester-records-round1-tar-gz); FuzzTesterMultiClient -fuzztime 10m
proof.observed: 29,998 documents, 162,876 marked text nodes, 660 map embeds refused alike; readers agree on all; multi-client fuzz 33,367 execs, nothing found
proof.negativeControl: A run join that ignores mark values (DeepEqual disabled) fails at history 00005

proof.criterion: A5/A8 refusals unchanged on every path; token cleanups change nothing
proof.surface: Dispatch API routes over stored trees outside the schema; Go fuzzing
proof.command: DISPATCH_TEST_DATABASE_URL=<local pg16+pgvector> go test ./internal/dispatch/api/ -run '^(TestEveryRouteAnswersAStoredTreeOutsideTheSchemaAlike|TestOutsideSchemaArtifactIsRepairableThroughUpload)$' at base (head test file and testhooks, base buildDocumentRead call) and head; -fuzz FuzzReadUnshared -fuzztime 10m; -fuzz FuzzTokenJSON -fuzztime 5m
proof.observed: 19 subtests pass at base and at head; FuzzReadUnshared 640,259 execs and FuzzTokenJSON 635,795 execs, nothing found
proof.negativeControl: foldLoaded returning the read error without documentSchemaError fails 8 of 9 corruptions: 500 INTERNAL instead of 409 DOC_SCHEMA

proof.criterion: A7 nothing more stays in memory
proof.surface: end-of-window heap profiles of the six runs; changed pmdoc source
proof.command: go tool pprof -top -sample_index=inuse_space <bin> heap.pprof; search of the changed pmdoc files for sync.Pool and package-level buffers
proof.observed: no sync.Pool or package-level buffer; ReadUnshared in-use 0.5-3 MB at head; read-cache placement data 173-182 MB head vs 168-191 MB base; total in-use 267-286 MB head vs 252-278 MB base, within run-to-run spread
proof.negativeControl: None that refuses: a heap reading has no refusal; the base runs bound the spread

notes: The implementer's tests catch every planted bug I tried except one: a walk that reads deleted format items is caught only by items/deleted_items_are_skipped. Neither the fuzzers nor 15,000 Yjs histories produced a deleted format item, so the hand-built case is the only lock, and it holds.
The LINUX corpus cannot see a run join that ignores mark values (its dumps stay identical); TestReadUnsharedReadsWhatReadReads and FuzzReadUnshared seeds catch it.
